CONTINUATION INTEGRITY PROTOCOL

Purpose:
Prevent continuation drift in new workspaces.

Top-level law:
No continuation artifact may infer, compress, rename, generalize, reorder, or widen any frozen phase, freeze state, authority distinction, routing scope, or artifact class unless the change is explicitly surfaced as a conflict and approved.

Required preflight before drafting:
The model must first output a Continuation Integrity Check with all of the following:

A. Frozen laws recognized exactly
- Restate the canonical laws without renaming or compression.

B. Frozen phase order recognized exactly
- Restate all 8 phases in exact order.

C. Frozen freeze taxonomy recognized exactly
- Restate the 3 freeze concepts distinctly:
  - draft freeze
  - definitive lock
  - surface freeze

D. Forbidden inferences recognized
- Do not invent councils or role taxonomies not already frozen.
- Do not widen authority ownership.
- Do not widen routing grammar beyond frozen scope.
- Do not rename stages.
- Do not collapse artifact classes into artifact states.
- Do not collapse derivative artifacts into packaging outputs.

E. Drift check against intended artifact
- State whether the next artifact can be drafted safely from frozen canon.
- If not, stop and report the conflict.

Blocking rule:
If any frozen distinction is omitted, renamed, merged, generalized, or widened during preflight, drafting is blocked.

Recovery rule:
Any artifact generated after a failed preflight is invalid by default and must be treated as drifted output until explicitly reviewed.

Promotion rule:
No continuation-generated artifact is promotable unless preflight passed first.

  - promotion_and_deduplication_follow_foil_and_must_be_ledgered
  - frozen_surface_artifacts_precede_final_suno_prompt_packaging

    - log

    - compress_before_definitive_technical_consensus
    - merge_distinct_semantics_for_convenience

null_handling:
  nulls_are_signal: true
  silent_fill_forbidden: true
  creative_fill_forbidden: true

    - preserve_nulls_explicitly
    - surface_nulls_to_smes_or_review_artifacts
    - block_false_completion
    - do_not_invent_resolution

progression_contract:
  phase_order:
    - "sequential axis completion"
    - "draft.technical.ust freeze"
    - "round-robin deliberation"
    - "definitive technical.ust lock"
    - "reverse promotion / deduplication"
    - "concurrent derivative surface drafting"
    - "surface freeze"
    - "packaging"

  zero_skip_rule:
    required: true
    description: downstream_progression_is_blocked_until_prior_phase_requirements_are_satisfied_without_skipping_axes

  phase_gates:
    "sequential axis completion":
      controller_must:
        - verify_all_required_axes_are_completed_sequentially
        - detect_omission_truncation_or_skip
        - reject_incomplete_axis_sets
      completion_condition:
        - no_axis_skipped
        - no_axis_marked_complete_if_incomplete

    "draft.technical.ust freeze":
      requires:
        - sequential_axis_completion_complete
      controller_must:
        - freeze_draft.technical.ust_without_relabeling
        - preserve_nulls_and_open_items_as_signal

    "round-robin deliberation":
      requires:
        - draft.technical.ust_frozen
      controller_must:
        - run_mandatory_argumentative_review
        - preserve_round_robin_notes_as_first_class_artifacts
        - preserve_contradiction_logs_and_governance_review_artifacts

    "definitive technical.ust lock":
      requires:
        - round_robin_deliberation_complete
      controller_must:
        - lock_technical.ust_as_definitive
        - block_reverse_compilation_before_lock

    "reverse promotion / deduplication":
      requires:
        - technical.ust_definitively_locked
      controller_must:
        - apply_foil_discipline
        - ledger_all_promotion_and_dedup_actions
        - preserve_distinct_semantics
      forbidden:
        - convenience_merges
        - unledgered_deduplication

    "concurrent derivative surface drafting":
      requires:
        - reverse_promotion_deduplication_complete
      controller_must:
        - derive_only_from_definitive_technical.ust
        - treat_creative_ust_as_downstream_shell
        - treat_show_summary_as_downstream_style_surface

    "surface freeze":
      requires:
        - draft.creative.ust_exists
        - draft.show.summary_exists
      controller_must:
        - freeze_creative_ust.txt
        - freeze_show_summary.txt
        - preserve_distinction_between_surface_drafts_and_frozen_surface_artifacts

    "packaging":
      requires:
        - creative_ust.txt_frozen
        - show_summary.txt_frozen
      controller_must:
        - package_only_after_surface_freeze
        - preserve_distinction_between_surface_artifacts_and_packaging_outputs

    - do_not_rename_stages

Use this rule instead:

a quoted string

a plain scalar

in prose outside YAML: code fences are fine

inside YAML: only YAML values

use:
